summary.name: Tricentis Agentic Quality Engineering Platform (formerly Tabnine)
summary.one_liner: Tricentis's enterprise platform of specialized AI quality agents (test creation, test automation, impact analysis, performance testing) under a single AI Workspace control plane; tabnine.com now redirects here after Tabnine became part of Tricentis.
use_cases: running targeted tests per code change
load and performance testing in CI/CD
governing AI agents with approval gates and audit trails
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Tricentis's Agentic Quality Engineering Platform, which deploys groups of AI agents across the software development lifecycle under one control plane (AI Workspace). Agentic Quality Intelligence analyzes code, requirements and configuration changes to find coverage gaps and select tests per change, and it claims up to 90% cuts in testing cycles. Agentic Test Creation turns requirements into test cases linked back to their source, and Agentic Test Automation builds end-to-end tests from natural-language descriptions using Tosca. Agentic Performance Testing (NeoLoad) designs and runs load scenarios and integrates with CI/CD. The page also states governance features such as configurable approval gates and audit trails, and MCP support.
notable: AI Workspace control plane for orchestrating quality agents with human-in-the-loop approval gates and audit trails
Built on Tosca, qTest, SeaLights and NeoLoad products
Claims support for 190+ technologies including SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, web and mobile
Page states Tricentis was named a Leader in Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI-Augmented Software Testing Tools (Oct 2025)
caveats: Page is largely marketing; no pricing is listed and the 'Get a demo' flow is the main call to action
Claimed productivity figures (up to 60%, up to 90% cycle reduction) are vendor-stated and unverified here
The Tabnine code-completion product named in the directory listings is not described on this page; the domain now redirects to Tricentis
